title: Warehouse AGV Multi-Robot Path Planning
prompt:
Create a 3D warehouse automated guided vehicle (AGV) simulation with multi-robot path planning and collision avoidance using Three.js. Multiple AGVs navigate a grid-based warehouse, picking up and delivering boxes. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background 0x2a2a3a.
- PerspectiveCamera at (15, 20, 15), looking at origin.
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x556677, intensity 0.6), directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.7) at (10, 15, 10), castShadow=true.
- Enable renderer shadow maps.

## Warehouse Layout
- Floor: 20x20 grid, each cell 2x2 units, total 40x40 units. Floor color 0x555566.
- Shelving racks: 4 rows of rectangular obstacles (boxes, 2x3x2 each, color 0x886644), placed at grid positions to create aisles. Leave clear paths between rows.
- 4 pickup stations (green floor markers, 2x2, at corners of the grid).
- 4 delivery stations (red floor markers, 2x2, at mid-edges of the grid).
- Load 'BoxAnimated.glb' as a cargo box template; scale to 0.5 units. Place 8 cargo boxes at random pickup stations.

## AGVs (Multi-Body)
- 4 AGV robots, each a flat cylinder (radius 0.6, height 0.3) with a colored top indicator.
- Colors: [0xff4444, 0x44ff44, 0x4444ff, 0xffff44].
- Each AGV has: position, velocity, target, carrying (boolean), cargo reference.
- Initial positions: one near each pickup station.
- Movement: grid-aligned A* pathfinding avoiding shelves and other AGVs.
- Speed: 3 units/sec. Smooth movement along path waypoints.
- **Collision avoidance**: if two AGVs are within 2 units and heading toward each other, one waits (lower index yields). No two AGVs may occupy the same grid cell simultaneously.

## Task Logic
- AGVs autonomously: (1) navigate to nearest pickup station with cargo, (2) pick up cargo (cargo attaches on top), (3) navigate to assigned delivery station, (4) drop off cargo.
- When cargo is delivered, it disappears and a new cargo spawns at a random pickup station after 2 seconds.
- Track total deliveries.

## Controls
- Press Space to pause/play.
- Press 'R' to reset all AGVs and cargo.
- Press 'S' to step one frame when paused.
- Slider (id='slider-agv-speed', range 1 to 8, step 0.5, default 3) for AGV speed.
- Slider (id='slider-agv-count', range 1 to 4, step 1, default 4) for active AGV count.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Active AGVs (id='hud-agvs'): count of active AGVs
- Deliveries (id='hud-deliveries'): total completed deliveries
- Cargo waiting (id='hud-cargo'): cargo boxes at pickup stations
- Collisions avoided (id='hud-avoided'): times an AGV yielded to avoid collision
- Paused (id='hud-paused'): 'Playing' or 'Paused'
- Model loaded (id='hud-model'): 'Yes' or 'No'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `activeAGVs`: number
- `totalDeliveries`: number
- `cargoWaiting`: number
- `collisionsAvoided`: number
- `isPaused`: boolean
- `agvSpeed`: number
- `modelLoaded`: boolean
- `frameCount`: number
- `agvsValid`: boolean (no NaN in AGV positions)
- `avgPathLength`: number (average remaining path length across AGVs, rounded to 1 decimal)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: No two AGVs may occupy the same grid cell simultaneously. AGVs must not path through shelving racks. Collision avoidance: lower-index AGV has priority. Cargo must visually attach to AGV when carried. Delivery count must monotonically increase. No NaN in AGV positions.
